text: I want to share my experience at the dental clinic. I have to say, I'm extremely afraid of dental work. I won't go unless it's really unbearable. Before this, I had a terrible toothache, so much so that I decided to get it extracted. When I arrived at the clinic, the dentist was incredibly kind (I'm not exaggerating, he was genuinely amazing!). He had me lie down on the chair for an examination. He gave me excellent advice. There were two treatment options: root canal treatment or extraction. I chose extraction because the pain was unbearable. I told him about my fear of dental work. He applied a numbing cream and then injected a local anesthetic. I have to say, it didn't hurt at all when he injected it. The dentist was incredibly gentle. After the extraction, he had me bite on a gauze pad, and I can honestly say it didn't hurt at all. Even after the anesthetic wore off, there was still no pain. I could eat normally afterward. I want to emphasize how gentle the dentist was and how excellent the service was. Thank you for the wonderful service. If you're as afraid as I am, I highly recommend this clinic! (Dr. Kittipong's Dental Clinic).
